title.value: Predicting Tactical Solutions to Operational Planning Problems under Imperfect Information
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning of the text.
title.quote: Predicting Tactical Solutions to Operational Planning Problems under Imperfect Information

analysis.description: This paper discusses a methodology for predicting expected tactical descriptions of operational solutions (TDOSs) using machine learning and operations research. It focuses on a two-stage stochastic programming problem where the second stage is computationally intensive. The paper describes a method to quickly predict these solutions to support planning decisions and avoid generating multiple scenarios and solutions online. The methodology combines machine learning for approximating solutions with deterministic optimization models for generating a training dataset. The application is illustrated on a load planning problem for rail freight transportation, showing the efficacy of using deep learning models for accurate and quick predictions.
